quarterly_data.signal: Amtech Systems' 10-K for fiscal 2025 (year ended September 30, 2025): no customer accounted for 10% of net revenues in 2025 or 2024. At the end of 2025 two customers individually accounted for 29% and 11% of total backlog, and no other customer exceeded 10% of backlog; the filing does not name them. Its customers are primarily manufacturers of semiconductor substrates and devices and electronic assemblies. The filing says the improvement in lead times across all product lines during 2025 favorably contributed to the decline in backlog.
quarterly_data.figure: no customer at 10% of FY2025 revenue; two customers 29% and 11% of backlog at fiscal 2025 year-end
